items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And Milt tried to push me off of the boat.

ctx.x: And Milt tried to push me off of the boat. And Al McKibben was sitting like -- you know, I was standing here, and like this was the rail of the boat, so Al was sitting inside like this, you know, beside me. Because we had been talking. I was saying, "I remember this, and I remember this." So he runs up to push me, and Al says, "Look out, Kenny," and he grabbed him. I said, "What are you trying to do, man? Are you crazy." So he looked at me and said, "I'll kill you." So Al McKibben said, "No, you won't, either.…
